entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Unbelievable. Holding for ten minutes. This is ridiculous.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Yeah, 'Alex', I want to return this helmet I bought. I've had it with this company. I want my money back now.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could I have your order number?
It's VF88602. And don't give me the runaround. The color is completely wrong, it looks nothing like the picture. The box is still unopened, I haven't even touched the thing.
I understand your frustration with the color discrepancy. Just to be clear, is the issue a matter of preference with the color, or is there a technical fault with the helmet itself?

Are you serious? The issue is that I paid for something and I don't want it! What kind of company questions customer safety by trying to force them to keep gear they're unhappy with? I want a refund! Get me your manager right now, I'm not dealing with you.
There's no need for that, sir. I can handle this for you. Let me just pull up our return policy against your order date. One moment please.
Okay, I've got your order details here. I see the helmet was delivered 48 days ago. According to our policy, you are well within the 90-day return window for standard items.
Oh. So you can return it then?

Yes, absolutely. Since the box is unopened, I can process this for you immediately. I'm sending a prepaid return label to the email we have on file. Once we receive the item, we'll issue a full refund to your original payment method. Does that work for you?
Fine. Yes, that's what I wanted in the first place. Email it over.
The email has just been sent. You should receive it within the next few minutes. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
